status.pending: Each status.* key: an approval request's state, on a badge.
status.approved: Status badge on an approval request a socio (AI agent) made: the person approved it.
status.denied: Status badge on an approval request: the person denied it.
status.expired: Status badge on an approval request: nobody decided before it expired.
status.failed: Status badge on an approval request: it was approved but the action failed.
status.undone: Status badge on an approval request: an automatic approval was reversed afterward.
status.bypass: Approved by the Bypass policy, without asking the person.
status.auto: {{status}} is a status (status.*) an automatic review decided.
decided.auto: Each decided.* key: the line on an approval card once decided. "The socio" is the AI agent that asked; it carries on with its work after the decision. The _denied forms start with "Denied".
decided.expired: Line at the bottom of an approval card when the request expired before anyone decided.
decided.plain: Line at the bottom of an approval card once decided; the _denied form is for a denied request.
decided.waiting: The socio waits for the person's other decisions from the same turn; the count is how many.
decided.running: Line on an approval card right after the decision, while the socio (AI agent) continues its work; the _denied form is for a denied request.
decided.done: Line on an approval card once the socio finished continuing its work in the chat; the _denied form is for a denied request.
decided.failed: {{detail}} is the reason, from the server, or decided.turn-failed.
decided.turn-failed: Fallback reason inside decided.failed, after a colon, so it starts lowercase.
decided.skipped: {{detail}} is why the socio didn't carry on, from the server, or decided.not-carried-on.
decided.not-carried-on: Fallback reason inside decided.skipped when the server gives none.
auto.badge: Auto review: a model that decides routine requests in the person's place. Badge on an automatic review.
auto.escalated: Before the review's reason: it sent the request to the person to decide.
auto.approved: Lead-in on an approval card before the auto review's reason, when the automatic review approved the request.
auto.denied: Lead-in on an approval card before the auto review's reason, when the automatic review denied the request.
auto.model: {{model}} is the model's name. The forms say which connection it ran on: the default one, or the person's own.
auto.model-time: The same, with how many seconds the review took.
auto.undone: {{outcome}} is what undoing did, from the server.
auto.undo-failed: {{outcome}} is the server's message on why reversing an automatic approval failed.
card.label: Accessible name of an approval request's card, and its heading while it loads.
card.asks: The card's heading: {{socio}} is the socio's name, {{capability}} what it asks to do (from the server, in English).
card.approve: Button on an approval card or on the bar above the message box that approves the socio's request.
card.deny: Button on an approval card or on the bar above the message box that denies the socio's request.
card.undo: Button on an approval card that reverses an automatic approval.
card.open-first: When long parameters must be opened on the card before it can be approved.
card.until: <expires/> is the date the request expires; keep the tag.
card.loading: Shown on an approval card while its request loads.
card.open: Link to the request's own page in Approvals.
card.load-failed: Error on an approval card when its request could not be loaded.
card.save-failed: Error after Approve or Deny on an approval card when the decision could not be saved.
bar.label: The bar over the chat's message box while a request waits.
bar.asks: {{socio}} is the socio's name, {{capability}} the action, in the infinitive, from the server in English ("create datasets").
bar.position: When several requests wait: this is the first of them.
bar.on-card: Hint on the pending-approval bar above the chat's message box when the request must be decided on its card in the chat.
bar.open-first: Hint on the pending-approval bar when the request's long parameters must be opened on its card before it can be approved.
bar.show: Button that scrolls to the request's card.
panel.title: Heading of the panel, on a socio's page, of its requests waiting for the person.
panel.failed: Shown in the Waiting for you panel on a socio's page when its requests could not load.
panel.empty: Shown in the Waiting for you panel on a socio's page when no requests wait.
panel.now: How long ago a request was made, under a minute.
panel.minutes: How long ago, short, in minutes.
panel.hours: How long ago, short, in hours.
panel.date: When a request was made, as a date and time, for requests older than a day; {{at}} is that moment.
request.crumb: Breadcrumb in the header on a request's own page; links to the Approvals page.
request.crumb-request: Last breadcrumb in the header, on a request's own page.
request.title: Title of a request's own page. "Socio" is a product noun: an AI agent.
request.description: <all> wraps a link to the Approvals page; keep the tags.
